companies_domain_uq.name: companies_domain_uq
companies_domain_uq.where: "companies"."domain" is not null and "companies"."deleted_at" is null

contacts_email_uq.name: contacts_email_uq
contacts_email_uq.where: "contacts"."email" is not null and "contacts"."deleted_at" is null

invitations_role_ck.name: invitations_role_ck
invitations_role_ck.value: ("invitations"."org_id" is not null and "invitations"."member_role" is not null and "invitations"."staff_role" is null) or ("invitations"."org_id" is null and "invitations"."staff_role" is not null and "invitations"."member_role" is null)

tasks_project_org_ck.name: tasks_project_org_ck
tasks_project_org_ck.value: "tasks"."project_id" is null or "tasks"."org_id" is not null
